overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The Board's account that its Chair set hearing rules with counsel and no quorum met was credited, so no outside deliberation was shown.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting between two emails about a hearing, because hearing rules changed in that gap.
allegations.key_passage: We find, therefore, that the Board did not meet outside of a posted meeting between September 17 and September 24.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board sought legal advice outside a posted meeting during the same period when the hearing rules were revised.
allegations.key_passage: Absent sufficient evidence to the contrary, we credit a public body's account of the facts.
